name: Chto zh, eksperiment?
source:
This place, from free racial prejudice, is an experimental association of countries, and anyone can settle there.

The main character, a 14-year-old boy from China, was one of many who moved there in search of happiness.

He appreciates new cultures and languages, while making new acquaintances along the way.
Only now he does not immediately begin to understand that from now on the path to his usual life is forever cut off.

[Translated from [url=https://alandy.itch.io/well-experement]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个地方，没有自由的种族偏见，是一个实验性的国家联合体，任何人都可以在那里定居。

主角是一名来自中国的14岁男孩，他是众多为了寻找幸福而搬到那里的人之一。

他欣赏新的文化和语言，同时结识新朋友。
只是现在他还没有立刻明白，从此以后他通往平常生活的道路就永远断绝了。

[译自[url=https://alandy.itch.io/well-experement]itch.io[/url]]
